verdict.rationale: Qdrant documents a distributed deployment mode in which multiple peers distribute data "to extend the storage capabilities and increase stability." This points toward multi-node availability, and sharding is mentioned in the agent-skills material. The pack never explicitly describes replication, zone placement or a consistency model. Missing for 10: explicit replication factor/replica documentation, cross-zone/AZ placement, a documented consistency model (e.g. write consistency/ordering guarantees), failover behavior, and independent hands-on corroboration of HA.
